patch.summary:
Choose Meltwater only if your buying job matches “Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (St” rather than Uniqode's shape. Choose Uniqode only if your buying job matches “Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR;” rather than Meltwater's shape. Workflow advantage: Meltwater leans brand-monitoring, analytics; Uniqode leans lead-generation, content-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Meltwater is Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (Starter/Pro/Enterprise/Agency).; Uniqode is Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR; paid dynamic from researched ~$9/mo floor..
- Company-size focus: Meltwater (mid-market, enterprise) vs Uniqode (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Meltwater-leaning brand-monitoring, analytics vs Uniqode-leaning lead-generation, content-marketing.
- Researched limits: Meltwater — Opaque custom pricing only; Uniqode — Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Meltwater: Opaque custom pricing only; Not a social scheduler or publishing suite; Uniqode: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite; Plan cards hard to verify without live checkout.
